posts.title: Goodbye Last.fm!
posts.description: Last.fm recently announced ↗ they will require pro subscription for API keys. I created my last.fm account back in Nov, 2005 and closed it this week. 123K scrobbles. They invented scrobbling (as far as I remember), created a fantastic community, and were one of the pioneers of music recommendation. I feel grateful for this awesome service. Hello ListenBrainz ↗ ! I’m already loving the integration

posts.title: To AI or not to
posts.description: A year back we had discussed productivity vs joy as a framework for AI usage. This note looks at it from a create vs consume lens. Human and AI as creators versus consumers. X-axis is creation, Y-axis is consumption. (1) Human created content consumed by AI, (2) AI as both creator and consumer, (3) AI created content for Human consumption, (4) Humans are creators and consumers. Let’s go in order.
